definitions.short: to act as gatekeeper ; (figuratively) to estimate
definitions.full: H8176. shaar II. שָׁעַר verb calculate, reakon (Late Hebrew Pi`el Jewish-Aramaic Pa`el put a valuation, estimate ; Jewish-Aramaic שַׁעֲרָא interest, market-price ; Arabic market-price is loan-word Frä 189 ); — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular ׳כְּמוֺשֿׁ כֶּןהֿוּא בְּנַפְשׁוֺ Prov 23:7 as he has calculated in his soul, so is he , but dubious: De שֹׁעֵר as one who calculates ; more radical conjectures in Bi Toy.
definitions.rootNote: a primitive root; to split or open , i.e. (literally, but only as denominative from 8179 ); compare see 7778
